title: DetailBoardSection
description: One section of a node or fleet board: the board fields this section answers, read by its own request. The fields of every section of one selection, joined key by key, make the board of /api/history/board.

fields.description: The section's board fields with the values of /api/history/board. A field split between sections (kpis, kpis.spark, series) holds only this section's keys.
